blocker_results.basis: Repository-backed packaged, repository source, package-root, nested-working-directory, external-working-directory, and detached clean-extraction candidate invocations all returned PASS 23/23. Detached mode used the frozen archive source_payload without a repository ancestor. A separate P2 validation-accounting finding remains open.

The validator enforces existence and nonempty fields but not the truth or compatibility of requirement, control, gap, finding, remediation, test, role, rationale, and evidence relationships. A detached mutation probe replaced those relationships with bogus or unrelated values and MV-011A still passed with no errors.

Startup attempts are now event-derived with complete arithmetic, but provider_register still emits provider_path_evaluated=true and eleven skipped provider outcomes from only configuration state plus a supplied zero network ledger; no provider implementation path is evaluated.

Quoted and assignment-form probes improved, but the before projection is generated by applying the same redactor as the after projection. A schema-valid record lost the outcome text authentication denied during over-redaction yet passed both schema and semantic validation. Bare Bearer values and access_token/client_secret assignments also remain undetected.

Executable, full argv, cwd, PPID, PGID, nonce, listener attribution, timeout, and conflict controls materially improved. However _expected and status do not compare the recorded controlled_port to the kind-specific controlled port; a record declaring ports 9998/9999 was accepted as live and listener-verified for 27029/8019.

findings.title: Assembly validator double-counts one checksum control and validation command evidence is stale
evidence: Assembly validation reports 24/24 because MV-019-checksum-reconciliation is appended twice; there are only 23 unique assembly check identifiers.
STAGE2A_VALIDATION_COMMAND_REGISTER.json records PASS_10_OF_10 for the unit suite, while the immutable source contains and the read-only rerun executes 21 passing tests.
findings.impact: The frozen validation evidence overcounts assembly controls and is not reproducible as an exact test-count record.
findings.required_remediation: Emit MV-019 exactly once, enforce unique check identifiers, regenerate the invocation matrix from the final validator, and record the actual unit-test count.

findings.title: Traceability validation checks shape and existence rather than relationship truth
evidence: A detached assembly probe changed the provider output row to BOGUS-CONTROL, BOGUS-FINDING, S2-GAP-001, unrelated S2A-TEST-TOOLCHAIN, and arbitrary nonempty role/rule/rationale.
The same probe remapped the provider finding to unrelated but existing toolchain remediation/test/evidence and replaced REQ-009 source/test/evidence identifiers with nonexistent values.

The detached validator still returned PASS 24/24 and MV-011A reported errors=[] because requirement source/test/evidence references, output control/gap/finding IDs, and cross-entity compatibility are not validated.
findings.impact: The matrices can be complete and hash-valid while materially misstating which controls, executable tests, findings, remediation artifacts, and evidence support an output.
findings.required_remediation: Define and validate closed identifier sets and explicit cross-register compatibility for every requirement, control, gap, finding, remediation, test, source, evidence, artifact role, and verification rule. Add negative mutation tests that must fail.

findings.title: Per-provider path evaluation remains asserted rather than observed
evidence: provider_register accepts only an environment and a network-ledger mapping; it receives no provider callback, provider event stream, or provider implementation-path observation.
A pure call with a fabricated syntactically valid zero ledger returned eleven rows with provider_path_evaluated=true, attempted=0, and skipped=1 for every provider even though no provider path ran.

Nonzero unattributed network counts now fail closed and the three full-start attempts have event-derived attempted/succeeded/failed/skipped/timed-out/unavailable arithmetic; those improvements do not substantiate the per-provider evaluated claim.
findings.impact: The package cannot distinguish an actually evaluated skip prerequisite from a row synthesized after startup from configuration names and a global zero counter.
findings.required_remediation: Instrument each provider prerequisite or provider boundary with attributable, timestamped outcome events and derive each register row from those events. Do not set provider_path_evaluated without an observed event.

findings.title: Semantic projection is tautological and accepts material meaning loss
evidence: capture computes semantic_projection_sha256_before from redact_output(raw) and semantic_projection_sha256_after from the already redacted stream, so equality compares two instances of the same redacted projection rather than pre-redaction meaning with post-redaction meaning.
The raw line operation=login password=hunter2 authentication denied was stored as operation=login password=<REDACTED>, removing authentication denied.
With required_meaning set to the separate exact line run complete, a complete schema-valid record passed schema validation and validate_record_semantics with no errors despite the lost outcome text.
Bare Bearer abc.def.ghi, access_token=opaque-value, and client_secret=opaque-value produced zero replacements and zero residual-sensitive matches.
findings.impact: Evidence can be marked meaning-preserved while material result text is removed, and common credential forms can remain unredacted.
findings.required_remediation: Use an independently defined semantic projection that extracts required result fields before redaction, validate those fields after redaction, broaden credential detection, and add full-record negative tests for over-redaction and bare/token-prefixed credential forms.

findings.title: Recorded controlled-port identity is not enforced by expected-process or status checks
evidence: _expected validates PID, PGID, parent, full argv hash, executable, nonce, executable file, and working directory but never checks record.controlled_port.

A pure conflict probe supplied otherwise valid Mongo/API identities whose records declared ports 9998/9999; _expected returned true and status reported both processes alive and listener_identity_verified for the fixed ports 27029/8019 with no attribution conflict.
_terminate checks the recorded port later and would refuse signaling, but status and the process_identity foundation check can certify an internally conflicting identity before shutdown.
findings.impact: One declared identity field can conflict while startup/status evidence still reports the process identity as verified.
findings.required_remediation: Pass the expected controlled port into _expected, require exact equality in status and pre-signal checks, validate identity_recorded_utc, and add controlled-port mismatch plus PPID/executable/cwd negative tests.
